newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day Supersport Series cricket matches on Sunday:
In Cape Town: Western Province 220 and 342-6 (S.Koenig 97, D.Haynes 71), Northern Transvaal 355.
In Durban: Natal 332 and 257 (S.Pollock 77, D.Watson 75), Border 205 and 70-1.
In Paarl: Boland 268 and 260 (K.Jackson 70, A.Kuiper 63), Griqualand West 250 (P.Barnard 64).
